newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real rises 0.01 pct on dollar inflows.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real rises 0.01 pct on dollar inflows.

text.p: Brazil's real closed at 1.0765 per dollar, up 0.01 percent on dollar inflows in the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
At 1640 local/1940 GMT, preliminary figures for commercial and financial forex contracts showed a $199 million surplus. On Monday, forex contracts posted a $250.3 million surplus.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real closed at 1.0822 per dollar, down 0.03 percent.
In the parallel market, the real fell 0.26 percent to end at 1.138 per dollar, traders said.
